description: Apply a previously previewed compound edit after revalidating stable project, sequence and target identities before activation or mutation. Requires the edit capability and exact preview confirmation token; changed targets require a fresh preview. Ripple plans require the reviewed sequence to be active for the read-only QE sync-lock preflight.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

plan.description: An edit plan: { sequence_id?, operations: [...] } with up to 100 insert_clip and remove_clip operations. Operations run in order, and each one's times refer to the timeline as the operations before it left it.

allow_large_ripple.description: ripple remove_clip: allow execution above large_ripple_threshold after the read-only mover estimate

include_linked.description: remove_clip without ripple: also remove linked audio/video partners (default true)

item_id.description: insert_clip: project item node ID or name

large_ripple_threshold.description: ripple remove_clip: refuse above this mover count unless allow_large_ripple is true (default 400)

ripple.description: remove_clip: close the gap with a verified sync-locked ripple delete (always takes linked partners)

start_seconds.description: insert_clip: timeline insert time in seconds (insert edit, sync-locked tracks shift)

sequence_id.description: Sequence name or ID to edit (activated first); defaults to the active sequence

name: apply_edit_plan

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.

title: Apply Edit Plan
